shots.title: The hand and the rope
shots.action: Frame 0 is already moving: a weathered hand hauls a wet rope over the gunwale, knuckles white, water streaming from the net's knots. The rope comes taut; the camera rises with the net and reveals young Simon standing in the boat in the morning mist, feet braced on the ribs.
shots.cam: ECU at gunwale level, 60 cm from the hand
shots.move: One continuous crane up and back (ECU → medium wide) over 4.6 s; no cut
shots.fg: Dripping net knots, rope fibres, water drops on the lens edge
shots.bg: Mist on the lake, the far shore's cliff as a pale shape, a second boat half-lost in mist
shots.light: Golden morning: low sun behind the mist, warm rim on hand and rope, cool blue shadow water
shots.trans: The net swings up across the lens and wipes the frame (covered switch) ◆
shots.sound: Rope creak under strain, drips, water lapping the hull, one distant gull
shots.music: Silence for 1 s, then the intimate motif: a solo plucked lyre phrase, one breath of ney

narration.text: Ο Άγιος Πέτρος ήταν ένας από τους δώδεκα μαθητές του Χριστού

shots.title: Hero: behind Christ
shots.emotion: Belonging; purpose (a glimpse of the man he will become)
shots.action: Flash-forward. On a ridge path the disciples walk in single file; Christ leads, Peter one pace behind Him, the others strung out after. Sunlight breaks over the ridge across them.
shots.move: Slow lateral track with the walkers; the camera stays low
shots.fg: Dry thistles and grass heads passing close
shots.bg: The lake far below, hills in layered haze
shots.light: The sun clears the ridge as they pass: flare and long warm light across the figures, backlit dust
shots.trans: The sun flare fills the frame and becomes the glitter on the lake (match on light)
shots.sound: Sandals on dust, wind over grass, fabric
shots.music: The motif rises a fourth, strings enter under it: a promise, not yet the theme

narration.text: και ένας από τους κορυφαίους Αποστόλους.

shots.title: The cast net
shots.action: Simon swings a circular cast net and throws; it blooms open overhead against the sky, the lead weights ringing its edge.
shots.cam: Water level beside the boat, low angle up at Simon
shots.move: Slight handheld bob with the swell
shots.fg: Water surface filling the lower third; a splash hits the lens
shots.bg: Sky, a gull crossing, the mast
shots.light: Morning sun from frame left, warm skin, sun through the net's mesh
shots.trans: Cut on action as the net hits the water
shots.sound: The net's whoosh, weights hissing into the water, lap of waves
shots.music: Motif continues, lighter; frame drum brushed, not beaten

shots.title: Simon
shots.emotion: Quick grin, alert, impatient for the catch
shots.action: He watches the net sink, wipes lake water off his brow with a forearm and grins at something off-screen. His name lands on his face.
shots.move: Locked, tiny drift with the boat
shots.fg: Out-of-focus rope coil on the gunwale
shots.light: Warm key from the sun, bounce off the water under the chin
shots.sound: Water, boat creak, a man calling across the water (no words)

shots.title: Lake Gennesaret
shots.action: Establishing: the lake in the morning, three boats working, Simon's boat midground with him and Andrew, the black-basalt village of Capernaum on the shore, women spreading nets on the stones.
shots.cam: Wide, at water level from a moored boat's bow
shots.move: Slow lateral drift, left to right
shots.fg: Another boat's prow and furled sail crossing the foreground
shots.bg: Capernaum's basalt houses, smoke from a hearth, Mt Arbel
shots.light: Golden morning, haze thinning, water glitter
shots.sound: Gulls, oars, voices far off, water
shots.music: Motif with a low cello pedal

shots.title: Hauling with Andrew
shots.action: Simon and Andrew haul the dragnet rope hand over hand, leaning back, feet braced; the weight wins for a second, the rope slips, Simon laughs and shoulders Andrew and they heave again.
shots.cam: Medium two-shot from the stern, slightly low
shots.fg: Rope running through the frame, taut and wet
shots.bg: The net's cork floats curving on the water
shots.light: Sun higher, harder shadows, sweat catching light
shots.sound: Rope creak, grunts of effort, a short laugh (no words), splashes
shots.music: Frame drum picks up a work rhythm

shots.title: Into the shallows
shots.action: Without waiting, Simon vaults over the side into waist-deep water.
shots.move: Locked; the splash hits the lens
shots.light: Backlit spray
shots.sound: A big splash, then underwater-muffled for 4 frames

shots.title: The boat ashore
shots.emotion: Zeal: all his weight in it
shots.action: He drags the bow up the pebbles with his shoulder in it, the keel grinding; he slaps the hull, done.
shots.cam: Low on the shore, bow toward camera
shots.move: Slight push as the bow comes on
shots.light: Warm morning, wet skin
shots.sound: Keel grinding on pebbles, water draining

shots.title: A shadow on the net
shots.action: Peter mends a torn net by the beached boat, a wooden netting needle passing through the mesh. A shadow falls across the net. Focus racks from his hands to Christ, standing a few paces off on the shore.
shots.move: Locked; rack focus from hands to Christ
shots.light: Late morning, soft; the shadow is the only change
shots.sound: Lap of water, the netting cord pulled tight, the breeze
shots.music: Almost nothing: one low sustained cello note

narration.text: Μια μέρα, ο Χριστός τον κάλεσε

shots.title: The look
shots.emotion: Surprise giving way to being seen
shots.action: Peter looks up. Hold the eye contact through the silence. Nothing theatrical: his hands stop moving.
shots.cam: MCU, eye level, just off Christ's eyeline
shots.light: Soft daylight, Christ's shadow on Peter's chest
shots.music: Peter's theme is introduced: four notes, cello, very quiet

shots.title: The net slips from his hands
shots.action: Christ turns and walks away along the shore. Peter's eyes follow Him, go to the boat, then down to the net in his hands. The camera tilts down with his gaze: his fingers slowly open and the net slides off into the boat.
shots.move: Slow tilt down following his eyeline
shots.bg: Christ walking away, small, out of focus
shots.light: Soft daylight
shots.sound: The wet net slumping into the hull

narration.text: άφησε τα δίχτυα του, τη βάρκα του και την προηγούμενη ζωή του,

shots.title: The abandoned net
shots.action: The camera stays behind in the boat. Peter steps onto the shore, catches up his blue-grey mantle from a rock ◆ and follows Christ along the waterline, growing smaller. The abandoned net stirs in the lake breeze.
shots.cam: Low in the boat's stern, net in the foreground
shots.fg: The net rocking gently on the planks
shots.bg: Peter and Christ walking away along the curve of the shore
shots.light: Warm daylight, sun glint on the water
shots.trans: The walking figures dissolve into the walking of 04.1 (motif: walking)
shots.sound: Water knocking the hull, the breeze, footsteps fading
shots.music: Theme completes its phrase and opens up with violas

shots.title: Close behind Him
shots.emotion: Fascinated; he listens rather than speaks
shots.action: Christ walks through ripe wheat, talking; Peter walks close behind, head tilted to catch every word; the other disciples follow.
shots.bg: Olive terraces and the lake below
shots.light: Warm daylight, wheat glowing
shots.music: Theme expands: strings in counterpoint, frame drum at walking pace

narration.text: Από τότε έζησε κοντά στον Ιησού,

shots.title: The teaching
shots.action: On a hillside above the lake Christ teaches a seated crowd; Peter sits at the front edge, chin on his fist, eyes on Him.
shots.cam: Behind the crowd, Peter in profile in the midground
shots.bg: Christ seated on a rock, the lake beyond
shots.light: Afternoon, warm
shots.sound: Crowd hush, wind, a child's murmur

shots.title: The crowd surges
shots.action: In a basalt village street people suddenly rush past toward something we do not see; Peter, jostled, turns and stares: he sees it, and his face tells us. Children weave through legs toward Christ.
shots.light: Midday, bright, deep shadows

shots.title: The storm
shots.action: Night squall on the lake: the boat heels, spray, Peter clinging to the gunwale; then the wind drops at once and the water goes glassy.
shots.move: Handheld, rolling; stops dead when the wind stops
shots.light: Storm grey-blue, then calm moonlight
shots.sound: Wind and waves, then sudden near silence
shots.music: The drum hits once and stops

shots.title: Who is this man?
shots.emotion: Growing realisation that the man he follows is unlike anyone
shots.action: In the stillness Peter exchanges an astonished glance with Andrew, then turns back to look at Christ standing at the bow. He does not blink. Holds across into clip 05's first words.
shots.bg: Christ, dark against the moonlit water
shots.light: Moonlight, cool; the first warm glow of dawn on the horizon ◆
shots.trans: Cut to daylight on the same eyes (match on eyes)
shots.sound: Drips from the rigging, water lapping

shots.title: Eager on the path
shots.action: Peter strides ahead up a rocky path, turns and waves the others on, laughing; he helps John up a boulder with one arm.
shots.bg: The great rock cliff of Caesarea Philippi ahead
shots.light: Late afternoon, warm
shots.sound: Springs and running water, footsteps on rock

shots.title: Beneath the rock
shots.action: The disciples gather on the rocks below the cliff. Christ, seated, looks up at them and asks (implied, no lip-sync): the conversation stops.
shots.light: Late afternoon, the cliff face glowing, the group in shade
shots.music: Music thins to a held chord

shots.title: The others hesitate
shots.action: The disciples glance at each other and look down. In the long silence Peter steps forward, almost before he knows he has moved.
shots.move: Slow push that finds Peter as he steps out
shots.light: Soft late sun; rim light starts to find Peter
shots.trans: Continuous push into 05.4 (cut on the step)

shots.title: «Εσύ είσαι ο Χριστός»
shots.action: On «Εσύ» Peter looks straight at Christ. An open, expressive hand comes up. His face is certain and very still through «είσαι ο Χριστός».
shots.light: Late afternoon: a soft warm rim around Peter; not supernatural
shots.music: Theme in full voice for four bars, strings unison

shots.title: Christ's answer
shots.action: Christ's face as «ο Υιός του Θεού του ζώντος» is spoken: calm, a faint smile. Behind His head the sinking sun flares and whitens.
shots.bg: The sun low over the cliff edge
shots.light: The sun flare whitens the frame and contracts to a single point of light
shots.trans: The point of light becomes a star above Tabor (sun glare → star)
shots.music: Theme resolves up; a high string harmonic sustains

narration.text: ο Υιός του Θεού του ζώντος».

shots.title: Tabor before dawn
shots.action: Mount Tabor's dome against a deep-blue predawn sky; four tiny figures climb a switchback path; wind moves the grass and oak branches.
shots.bg: The last stars, the plain in darkness
shots.light: Predawn blue, one bright star
shots.sound: Wind on the mountain, grass, a night bird
shots.music: Ethereal expansion begins: divided high strings, wordless vocal pad

narration.text: Ήταν επίσης παρών στη Μεταμόρφωση του Κυρίου,

shots.title: Three climb behind Him
shots.action: Peter, James and John climb behind Christ; wind whips their mantles; Peter breathing hard, John the youngest, James steady.
shots.cam: Medium from behind and below on the path
shots.move: Tracking up the slope behind them
shots.bg: The sky going from blue to grey
shots.light: Cold predawn, silhouettes against a pale sky

narration.text: μαζί με τον Ιάκωβο και τον Ιωάννη,

shots.title: The light
shots.action: The summit. The wind stops; the grass goes still. Light begins subtly around Christ and swells to white-gold. Peter's eyes widen, his breathing slows, he shields his eyes and sinks to one knee. The camera pulls slowly back past him: James and John prostrate, the luminous figure beyond, a bright cloud forming. Moses and Elijah are not shown ◆ (the narration names only the three).
shots.move: One slow pull-back to a wide of the summit; no cut
shots.bg: Christ in light, the bright cloud
shots.light: Divine white-gold from Christ, every other light source gone; clear, not an explosion
shots.trans: The light floods to white; cut to black; a torch passes (06→07)
shots.sound: Wind drops to nothing; a low air tone
shots.music: Full ethereal chord, then it thins to one high note as the white takes the frame

narration.text: βλέποντας τη θεία δόξα του Χριστού πάνω στο όρος Θαβώρ.

shots.title: The courtyard
shots.action: Black; a torch passes close across the lens and reveals the courtyard: servants and guards around a charcoal brazier, and in the background the bound Christ led up the stone stair into the high priest's house. Peter stands at the edge of the crowd, hood half up.
shots.cam: Wide, a little high (he is small and watched)
shots.fg: The passing torch, then dark heads
shots.bg: Guards with torches on the stair, Christ between them
shots.light: Cold blue moonlight; unstable torch orange; deep shadows
shots.sound: Fire crackle, murmur, a dog far off, soldiers' boots on the stair
shots.music: The theme breaks apart: two low notes, a long gap

narration.text: Όμως ο Πέτρος γνώρισε και τη δική του μεγάλη πτώση.

shots.title: At the fire
shots.action: Peter edges in among strangers at the charcoal fire and holds out his hands to it, elbows in, eyes down. (This framing is mirrored at dawn in 08.3.)
shots.cam: MCU across the fire, eye level
shots.bg: Faces lit orange, blue dark beyond
shots.light: Fire-lit from below; cold blue rim from the moon

narration.text: Τη νύχτα που συνέλαβαν τον Χριστό,

shots.title: Three denials
shots.action: One unbroken, tightening shot. (1) The servant girl lifts her oil lamp to his face; he answers quickly, composed, a small shake of the head. (2) A man at the fire points; a nervous glance, jaw tight, he shifts back. (3) Several turn on him; a sharp defensive movement, his hand cutting the air. Each denial, the camera is closer.
shots.cam: Starts MS, ends in a tight CU
shots.move: Handheld push-in in three surges, one per denial
shots.fg: The lamp, then shoulders crowding the frame
shots.light: Lamp and fire; warmth drains from the grade with each denial
shots.music: Low tremolo rising, cut dead at the third denial

narration.text: φοβήθηκε και Τον αρνήθηκε τρεις φορές.

shots.title: The silence
shots.action: Silence. The courtyard's movement slows. Across it, on the gallery between guards, Christ turns and looks at Peter (Luke 22:61) ◆. A rooster crows, distant and muffled ◆.
shots.move: Restrained slow motion (the one place in the film)
shots.light: Cold; Christ in a small pool of torchlight
shots.sound: Everything muffled as if underwater, then the rooster, far off

shots.title: His eyes
shots.action: ECU on his eyes: the understanding arrives and his face breaks.
shots.light: Nearly all warmth gone; a trace of blue

shots.title: Into the dark
shots.action: He pushes out through the gate into the dark street, stops against the wall, and breaks: his shoulders collapse, he covers his face, he slides down the stones. No screaming.
shots.cam: Static wide from the street, a lot of negative space around him
shots.fg: The dark street, a gutter with standing water
shots.bg: The gate's torchlight behind him, then darkness
shots.light: Cold blue moonlight only
shots.sound: Distant city at night, his muffled sobs
shots.music: Nothing; then a single note of the theme, alone

shots.title: The tear becomes the lake
shots.action: CU: tears fall between his fingers into the water standing in the gutter; rings spread in the moonlit puddle. The rings dissolve into ripples on the lake at dawn: the boat offshore with seven fishermen, mist, and on the shore a small fire with a figure beside it.
shots.cam: CU low on the puddle → wide at water level
shots.move: Slow tilt down to the puddle; the dissolve lands on a slow drift over the lake
shots.bg: The shore, the fire, the figure
shots.light: Cold moon → soft dawn gold, warm cream, muted blue
shots.sound: A drop, then lapping water rising in; gentle fire far off, morning birds
shots.music: The theme's first note returns, then the theme slowly on the ney

narration.text: μετάνοιά του όμως ήταν αληθινή. Μετά την

shots.title: He jumps in
shots.action: Peter recognises Him, throws his mantle round himself and plunges over the side, wading hard for the shore (echo of 02.5).
shots.cam: Water level at the shoreline, Peter coming toward camera
shots.light: Dawn backlight, spray lit gold

shots.title: At the fire again
shots.action: Dripping, Peter stands a little apart from the charcoal fire where Christ turns fish on the coals. Christ offers him bread. He takes it without raising his eyes. Same framing as 07.2, now in dawn warmth.
shots.bg: The lake, the others dragging the net ashore
shots.light: Warm fire and warm dawn: the cold of 07.2 is gone

shots.title: First question: shame
shots.action: Apart from the others, Christ and Peter sit on rocks by the water. Christ turns to him and speaks (implied, no lip-sync, no text). Peter's eyes stay on the ground; his hands are clenched on his knees.
shots.light: Sunrise just below the hills
shots.music: The theme's second phrase, cello joining

shots.title: Second: vulnerability
shots.action: Closer. Peter's eyes lift halfway; his mouth trembles; his hands slowly unclench.
shots.light: The first sun touching the far hills

shots.title: Third: acceptance
shots.emotion: Acceptance: he has not been rejected
shots.action: Peter looks directly at Christ. The sunrise's reflection off the water reaches his face. Christ's expression is calm. Not triumph: restoration.
shots.cam: Balanced, symmetrical two-shot, then Peter's face
shots.bg: The sun rising over the lake between them
shots.light: Warm reflected sunrise on Peter's face (key shot)
shots.trans: Cut to Peter's face in the upper room (match on face)
shots.music: The original melody returns complete, quietly

shots.title: The frightened man, once more
shots.action: Peter's face in the dim upper room, hooded, eyes low: exactly the composition of 07.5, for one moment.
shots.cam: CU, same lens and angle as 07.5
shots.light: A single oil lamp, dim

shots.title: The wind and the light
shots.action: A rushing wind: lamp flames bend flat, mantles lift and whip, warm light pours across the room and the faces. Fire-like light shines in Peter's eyes. He lifts his head; the fear is gone. No literal fantasy flames.
shots.move: Locked, then the frame reverses: he rises into it
shots.light: Warm amber rushing light, rich red-orange highlights
shots.sound: Low air movement swelling; restrained rising tone
shots.music: The theme in full for the first time, tutti

narration.text: ο Πέτρος γέμισε με τη δύναμη του Αγίου Πνεύματος.

shots.title: Toward the crowd
shots.action: The composition of 07.1 reversed: instead of hiding in a crowd, Peter steps out of the doorway into the bright street toward one.
shots.move: Following him out into the light
shots.bg: Jerusalem street and crowd in sunlight
shots.light: From dim interior into blazing day

shots.title: Preaching
shots.action: Peter preaches from the southern steps with controlled, open gestures.
shots.light: Bright Mediterranean day
shots.sound: Crowd hush, his voice unheard under the narration

shots.title: Thousands
shots.action: The camera cranes back and up from Peter until the steps and the plaza are full: more and more people, thousands, still and listening; some kneel.
shots.move: One crane back and up; peaks on «χιλιάδες»
shots.bg: The Temple walls, the city beyond
shots.light: Full day

narration.text: Κήρυξε στα Ιεροσόλυμα και χιλιάδες άνθρωποι πίστεψαν στον Χριστό.

shots.title: He helps a man rise
shots.action: At a gate Peter takes the hand of a lame man and helps him up; the man's weight comes onto his feet (hands: healing).
shots.move: Tilt up with the man as he rises
shots.light: Warm day

shots.title: The first Christians
shots.action: In a courtyard, believers share bread; Peter breaks a loaf and passes it, then steadies an old woman's arm.
shots.light: Warm late day

shots.title: The long road
shots.action: Peter walks alone along a coastal road, very small against the hills; his beard is fuller, his mantle faded.
shots.light: Bright Mediterranean day

shots.title: Aboard
shots.action: He steps aboard a small merchant ship; the sail fills.
shots.light: Day
shots.trans: Match to the road in 10.1 (motif: walking)

shots.title: The road to Rome
shots.action: Peter walks toward camera along the Via Appia between tombs and umbrella pines. An ox cart passes through the foreground and covers him.
shots.light: Dusty sunlight
shots.trans: The cart covers the frame; when it clears, years have passed

narration.text: Η παράδοση της Εκκλησίας αναφέρει ότι

shots.title: Rome rises
shots.action: The cart clears: the same walk, but Peter is old, grey-bearded and travel-worn. As he walks past us the camera rises and Rome rises behind him: the aqueduct arches striding to the city, roofs and temples in haze.
shots.bg: The Aqua Claudia and the city
shots.light: Hard stone-grey sunlight, dust

narration.text: ο Απόστολος Πέτρος έφτασε μέχρι τη Ρώμη.

shots.title: Tiny in the city
shots.action: A dense Roman street: carts, soldiers, crowds, colonnades. Peter is a tiny figure crossing among them.
shots.fg: A column passes close (wipe into the next shot)
shots.light: Hard grey sunlight, terracotta and muted red
shots.trans: Passing Roman column → the gathering (covered switch)

narration.text: Εκεί συνέχισε να κηρύττει τον Χριστό,

shots.title: The hidden gathering
shots.action: In a low room a few dozen people listen quietly by lamplight; Peter, seated, speaks calmly with open hands. The lamp flames echo Pentecost's fire.
shots.bg: The stair to the street door
shots.light: Warm terracotta lamplight in a dark room

shots.title: Footsteps
shots.action: A young man by the stair watches nervously up toward the door. Hobnailed footsteps outside. Everyone freezes; a lamp flame trembles. Focus racks from the watcher to Peter, whose eyes lift to the door. Hold.
shots.cam: MCU watcher in the foreground, Peter seated in the background
shots.fg: The watcher, the stair rail, a trembling lamp
shots.bg: Peter; the door with a line of daylight under it, broken by passing shadows
shots.light: Lamplight vs. a cold line of day
shots.sound: Street noise faint through the door, then hobnailed caligae on stone, then silence
shots.music: A held dissonance, cut to silence

shots.title: He offers his hands
shots.action: Roman soldiers come down the stair with torches. Peter rises, raises a hand to calm the others, and holds out his wrists.
shots.light: Torch orange breaking into lamplight

shots.title: Bound
shots.action: CU: his old fisherman's hands are bound with rope (rope motif: the hands that hauled rope in 01.1).
shots.light: Torchlight

shots.title: The corridor
shots.action: Peter walks slowly between guards down a stone corridor; beams of light fall through narrow slits.
shots.bg: The bright opening at the end
shots.light: Quiet late-afternoon light through slits; cool stone

shots.title: The cross
shots.action: In the yard he sees an ordinary wooden cross structure lying ready. He lowers his eyes (on «θεωρούσε τον εαυτό του»), then looks upward.
shots.light: Warm late-day sun

narration.text: ανάποδα, γιατί θεωρούσε τον εαυτό του

shots.title: In silhouette
shots.action: Silhouette at great distance: by the Circus obelisk, workers raise the execution structure. The composition (its long shadow on the sand) makes clear it is inverted, with no detail of the body.
shots.light: Late sun behind: everything in silhouette

narration.text: ανάξιο να πεθάνει με τον ίδιο τρόπο

shots.title: Peace
shots.action: Close-up, older Peter: wind moves his hair and beard. A flicker of fear, then his face settles into peace. On «όπως ο Κύριός του» he looks up; the sky fills the frame with light.
shots.light: Warm late-day light, then the sky brightens to white
shots.music: The note opens into a soft major chord

shots.title: 29 June
shots.action: The white resolves into warm painted light: candle flames, parchment grain, June sun through a small window, and Peter's figure, still and icon-like. «29 Ιουνίου» is lettered quietly on the parchment ◆.
shots.light: Candlelight and a shaft of June sun

narration.text: Η Εκκλησία τιμά τη μνήμη του στις 29 Ιουνίου,

shots.title: Peter and Paul
shots.action: The pull-back reveals Paul beside him: the two apostles embrace, an icon-inspired composition (the Byzantine 'Embrace of the Apostles') painted in the film's own hand.
shots.light: Candle glow and window light

shots.title: Echo: the net
shots.action: Echo of 03.4: the abandoned net stirring in the boat.
shots.light: Golden, a touch softer than the original
shots.music: The theme in its first, gentle form, now with richer harmony

shots.title: Echo: he falls, he rises
shots.action: Echo of 07.6: Peter against the wall, face in his hands. On «σηκωθεί» it dissolves slowly into the echo of 08.6: Peter lifting his eyes to Christ in the sunrise.
shots.light: Cold, lifted a little → dawn
shots.music: Theme; the harmony turns from minor to major under «σηκωθεί»

narration.text: ότι ακόμη και ο άνθρωπος που πέφτει μπορεί να σηκωθεί,

shots.title: Echo: following
shots.action: Echo of 01.2 and 04.1: Peter walking close behind Christ in the wheat.
shots.light: Warm day

shots.title: Echo: His look
shots.emotion: Love that does not stop at weakness
shots.action: Echo of 07.4: Christ's look across the courtyard, re-graded from cold blue to warm ◆: the look was never condemnation.
shots.light: The torchlight warms to gold
shots.music: Theme, a new warm chord under the old melody

narration.text: Η αγάπη του Χριστού δεν σταματά στην αδυναμία μας,

shots.title: Echo: strong
shots.action: Echo of 09.5: Peter before the crowd.
shots.light: Day

narration.text: αλλά μας καλεί να γίνουμε ξανά δυνατοί,

shots.title: Echo: faithful and brave
shots.action: Echo of 10.2: old Peter walking toward Rome.
shots.light: Dusty gold

shots.title: Lake Gennesaret, morning
shots.action: Early morning on the lake. An empty fishing boat rocks gently; a net like the one he left lies in it. Golden light spreads across the water. Far off, two figures walk along the shore (no faces). Hold, then fade to warm light.
shots.cam: Wide at water level, boat in the near midground
shots.move: Locked; the light moves, not the camera
shots.fg: Water, the net in the boat
shots.bg: The shore, two tiny walking figures
shots.light: Dawn gold spreading across the lake (return to the opening light)
shots.music: The theme's opening four notes on the lyre, a final warm chord that rings out
